column1: # Custom partition table for the ESP32-S3 N16R8 (16 MB flash). Arduino IDE: Tools > Partition Scheme > Custom.
# The Arduino upload writes boot_app0 at 0xe000 and the app at 0x10000 (hard-coded in the core's platform.txt)
# app0 must stay at 0x9000 / 0xe000 / 0x10000. Do not move them (the meter then does not boot: "No bootable app partitions").
